description: Replace a single section's content by its heading. Only the targeted section is rewritten — the rest of the note is untouched. Include the heading line in the content. Requires 'write' scope.

content.description: The new content for this section, including the heading line. Everything between this heading and the next heading of equal or higher level.

heading.description: The exact heading text to find (without # prefix).

name: update_section
